response.sql: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day, COUNT(*) AS films FROM film WHERE rental_duration >= 5 GROUP BY rating) SELECT rating, avg_rate_per_day, films, avg_rate_per_day / (SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) FROM per_rating) AS ratio_to_benchmark FROM per_rating WHERE (SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) FROM per_rating) IS NOT NULL
